sources.name: Apex Park and Recreation District – Camps
sources.reason: Apex is the Arvada-area recreation district right next to Westminster. It runs three full-day, state-licensed camp sites, Teen Adventure, and a Leadership in Training program for ages 5–15 during Jeffco school breaks.

sources.name: Apex PRD – Gymnastics
sources.reason: Recurring gymnastics classes that start with parent-child classes at age 1 and go up to the team program.

sources.name: Apex PRD – Sports league registration (TeamSideline)
sources.reason: Lists Apex sports leagues with their registration status and open/close dates. Useful for spotting when youth and adult league registration opens.

sources.name: Apex PRD – League schedules (TeamSideline)
sources.reason: Game schedules for Apex youth leagues, including ages 5–6, at local rec centers.

sources.name: City of Northglenn – School Age Day Camp
sources.reason: Northglenn borders Westminster. Its day camp runs out of the Northglenn Recreation Center and includes swimming, gym time, field trips and pedal boats.

sources.name: City of Northglenn – Roving Recreation (youth & teens)
sources.reason: Summer-break outing program for youth and teens.

sources.name: City of Northglenn – Sports
sources.reason: Non-competitive youth sports programs that focus on fundamentals. They run on summer Friday mornings at Northwest Open Space.

sources.name: Arvada Center – Education
sources.reason: Recurring ceramics, dance, music and theater classes for children, teens and adults.

sources.name: Arvada Center – Summer Camps
sources.reason: Arts and theater summer camps for kids, with seasonal registration.

sources.name: Arvada Center – Dance Classes
sources.reason: Dance classes run in four sessions per year, and scholarship applications are taken before each session.

sources.name: Arvada Center – Spring Break Camps
sources.reason: Arts camps during school spring break.

sources.name: Denver Zoo Conservation Alliance – Safari Camps
sources.reason: Camps during fall, winter, spring and summer school breaks. They include animal encounters and zoo exploration, sorted by grade range.

sources.name: Denver Zoo – Summer Safari Camp Schedules
sources.reason: Summer camp schedules for each grade group.

sources.name: Uncover Colorado – Free Admission Days in Colorado 2026
sources.reason: Not an official source, but a yearly list of 2026 free days at Denver-area museums: Denver Art Museum (second Tuesdays and some weekends), Denver Botanic Gardens, Denver Museum of Nature & Science and others. Useful for checking dates against each museum's own site. Search quota ran out before official pages could be found.

sources.name: Mile High on the Cheap – Free Museum Days in Denver 2026
sources.reason: Not an official source, but a 2026 list that includes places not on the known list: Four Mile Historic Park (free fourth Fridays), Plains Conservation Center, Broomfield Veterans Museum (always free, close to Westminster) and Golden History Museum (always free).

sources.name: KDVR – Free days at Denver museums, zoo, parks and Colorado attractions in 2026
sources.reason: News list of 2026 free days, including dates not covered by the known sources: Colorado Railroad Museum (free on some Thursdays), Wings Over the Rockies Air and Space Museum, and themed free days at Plains Conservation Center.

sources.name: City of Westminster – Adult Athletics
sources.reason: The City of Westminster's main page for adult athletics. It links to its basketball, indoor soccer, pickleball and tennis, softball and volleyball leagues, which run on recurring seasons with online registration.

sources.name: City of Westminster – Adult Volleyball Leagues
sources.reason: Seasonal coed volleyball leagues (winter, spring and more). Games are on weeknights at West View Recreation Center, with set team fees and online registration.

sources.name: City of Westminster – Adult Indoor Soccer
sources.reason: Ongoing indoor soccer leagues at the Westminster Sports Center, with Gold, Silver and Bronze divisions. A good fit for groups of friends or coworkers.

sources.name: City of Westminster – Adult Softball
sources.reason: Spring and later-season softball leagues, with registration deadlines and captains' meetings.

sources.name: Arvada Center – Classes for Adults
sources.reason: Offers over 600 courses a year for adults in visual arts, drama, ceramics and dance. Each season has its own class catalog and registration opening date.

sources.name: Arvada Center – Ceramics Studio
sources.reason: Pottery classes from beginner to advanced wheel-throwing, plus 'Clay for Ageless Adults' classes for older adults and parent/child clay classes.

sources.name: Front Range Community College (Westminster campus) – Class Schedule
sources.reason: Front Range Community College's main campus is in Westminster. This page explains how to search the class schedule and register for terms.

events.title: Denver Zoo Fall/Winter/Spring Safari Camps – registration info
events.why: Explains how registration works: you buy a camp by date and grade range. A local magazine says the zoo's summer camps fill up fast.

events.title: Denver Zoo Safari Camps 2026 Policies & Procedures
events.why: Updated November 2025. Parents should check it before signing up for 2026 camps.

events.title: Apex PRD Summer 2026 league registrations
events.why: Shows the 2026 summer league registration windows. For example, regular registration for one league ran Feb 4 to Jun 7, 2026. Check here for when youth league sign-ups open.

events.title: Denver Museum of Nature & Science 2026 free days, including Día del Niño (Apr 26), Juneteenth (Jun 19) and Night at the Museums (Nov 7, 5–10 pm)
events.why: Free entry to Denver's biggest family science museum, plus special evenings like Girls & Science (Mar 6, 4–9 pm). Check the dates on dmns.org first.

events.title: Colorado Railroad Museum free Thursdays (Mar 12, May 7, Oct 1) and Wings Over the Rockies free days (May 19, Sep 20, Nov 19)
events.why: Free outings for kids who like trains and planes, both a short drive from Westminster. Check the dates on each museum's site before going.

events.title: Denver Art Museum 2026 free days (e.g., Apr 26, May 12, Jun 9, Jul 14, Aug 1, Sep 12, Nov 7, Dec 8)
events.why: Free entry to the whole museum campus. Weekend dates like Apr 26, Aug 1, Sep 12 and Nov 7 are easier for families. Check against the known DAM free-days page.

events.title: Four Mile Historic Park free fourth Fridays 2026 (e.g., Apr 24, Jun 26, Jul 24, Aug 28)
events.why: Free family visit to Denver's oldest pioneer farm site, a hands-on history outing for kids and visiting friends.

events.title: Westminster Spring Adult Softball 2026 – captains' meeting March 15, games start week of March 23
events.why: The captains' meeting is required and registration is open now. Spring fee is $275, with a $175 deposit to hold a spot. Good for forming a Korean community or friends team.

events.title: Westminster Spring Coed Volleyball league registration
events.why: Coed leagues are a good fit for mixed groups of friends. The next season follows the winter league (Jan 6–Mar 10, $345 per team).

events.title: Arvada Center Fall 2026 adult classes go on sale Friday, August 7 at 11:00 am
events.why: Popular art, ceramics and dance classes often sell out quickly. The 2026 Fall Class Catalog can already be downloaded.

events.title: Hyland Hills adult swing dance classes with Two Left Boots (ages 18+, drop-in OK)
events.why: A recurring weekly social dance series at Hyland Hills Sports Center in Westminster with low drop-in prices. No partner needed. The listing on this page is from 2024 (an earlier listing is from 2023), so check for current sessions.
